core_meaning.primary_meaning: Firuze is a Persian-origin name meaning “Turquoise”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Firuze corresponds to the Persian form فيروزة (Persian فیروزه (Fīrūza)). Its core sense is turquoise. Firuze is the Turkish/Persian form of فیروزه (Fīrūza) 'turquoise'. The source labelled it 'Arabic'; the word is Persian. The source gloss 'jewel, precious one' is a loose extension of the gem sense.

persian.name: فیروزه
